title: Causal Loop
dek: An event that is its own cause — no beginning, no author, no first time around.
also_known_as: Bootstrap paradox, ontological paradox, closed timelike curve

prose.label: The idea
prose.body: Information or matter travels back in time and becomes the cause of its own existence. There is no origin outside the loop — only consistency.

prose.label: In fiction
prose.body: Primer, Dark, and Steins;Gate stage loops where the attempt to escape is what closes the circle. John Titor's story is a folk version of the same geometry.
